==English==

===Etymology===
Topographic surname for someone who lived by a market.

===Proper noun===
{{en-proper noun|s}}

# {{surname|en}}.

====Statistics====
* According to the 2010 United States Census, ''Market'' is the 33567<sup>th</sup> most common surname in the United States, belonging to 679 individuals. ''Market'' is most common among White (73.64%) and Black/African American (22.24%) individuals.
